areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Illegal-deforestation enforcement and carbon-credit certification are clearly linked, but the indicator lacks a baseline, resources are minimal and impact is low.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: Tax simplification, business registry integration and foreign-trade integration relate to the area; only some indicators link directly; relevant resource share but low impact.

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: Transparency portal upgrades and ombudsman actions are directly linked with a verifiable indicator, but minimal resources give low impact.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Digital transformation is a core aim; indicators easily verified; relevant resource share; moderate impact; programme considered innovative and efficient versus usual tax management.

areas.name: Fiscal sustainability
areas.reason: Fiscal and tax management is the central focus; indicators easily verified; about half of resources; high impact; programme efficient versus alternatives.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: General objective not directly related; minimal resource share; leadership training for staff is not tied to the area's structural policies, so indicators are insufficient.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: Own solar generation in administrative buildings has no direct bearing on national energy security; minimal resources and insufficient indicators.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Rainwater reuse in the headquarters building does not materially affect national water security; minimal resources and insufficient indicators.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Link through inclusive procurement and training is not directly verifiable; no pertinent indicators and minimal resources, so impact cannot be measured.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: General objective directly related, but indicators do not clearly show the objectives are met; relevant resource share does not compensate for the lack of pertinent indicators.
